latin: Sciri potest ex praecedentibus conclusionibus quare intellectus agens quandoque arti, quandoque habitui, quandoque lumini, assimilatur.
translation: It can be known from the preceding conclusions why the agent intellect is likened sometimes to art, sometimes to a habit, sometimes to light.
